services.desc: Bayshore Grove provides the perfect, relaxed setting for your next corporate event or company clambake. From fine dining, bountiful buffets or a casual fare, our experienced culinary staff can create a menu that fits your personal needs. We are available for meetings, private parties, clambakes and picnics. Our staff understands there is but one chance to make every event special.
